<?php
class CopyA65 { public function __destruct() { echo 'A-DROP|'; } }
class CopyB65 { public function __destruct() { echo 'B-DROP|'; } }
function Make65Copy() {
    global $weakGiven;
    $value = new Exception('given65');
    $weakGiven = WeakReference::create($value);
    return $value;
}
function Run65Copy() {
    global $g;
    echo 'CALL|';
    $value = $g->throw(Make65Copy());
    echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($value === 'after65'), '|';
    return 'fiber65';
}
$source = new CopyA65();
$weakA = WeakReference::create($source);
$factory = function () use ($source) {
    global $weakGiven;
    try {
        echo 'ENTER|';
        Fiber::suspend('before65');
        echo 'FIRST|';
        yield 'seed65';
        echo 'BAD-TAIL|';
    } catch (Exception $caught) {
        echo 'CAUGHT|', (int) ($caught === $weakGiven->get()), '|';
        echo 'CAPTURE|', (int) ($source instanceof CopyA65), '|';
        yield 'after65';
        echo 'AFTER-YIELD|';
    }
    return 65;
};
$weakClosure = WeakReference::create($factory);
$g = $factory();
unset($factory);
echo 'FRESH|';
$f = new Fiber('Run65Copy');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'before65'), '|';
$source = new CopyB65();
$weakB = WeakReference::create($source);
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|',
     (int) ($weakA->get() !== null), '|',
     (int) ($weakClosure->get() !== null), '|',
     (int) ($weakGiven->get() !== null), '|';
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume() === null), '|';
echo 'FIBER|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber65'), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 65), '|',
     (int) ($weakA->get() !== null), '|',
     (int) ($weakClosure->get() !== null), '|';
unset($source);
echo 'B|', (int) ($weakB->get() === null), '|';
unset($g, $f);
echo 'DROP|', (int) ($weakA->get() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakClosure->get() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakGiven->get() === null), '|';
unset($weakA, $weakB, $weakClosure, $weakGiven);
echo 'E';

function Make65Normal() {
    global $weakGiven;
    $value = new Exception('given65');
    $weakGiven = WeakReference::create($value);
    return $value;
}
function Run65Normal() {
    global $g, $weakGiven;
    echo 'CALL|';
    try {
        $g->throw(Make65Normal());
        echo 'BAD-RETURN|';
    } catch (Throwable $outside) {
        echo 'OUTSIDE|', (int) ($outside === $weakGiven->get()), '|',
             (int) ($outside->getPrevious() === null), '|';
    }
    return 'fiber65';
}
$token = new Cache65Normal();
$weakToken = WeakReference::create($token);
$factory = function () use ($token) {
    try {
        echo 'ENTER|';
        Fiber::suspend('before65');
        echo 'FIRST|';
        yield $token;
        echo 'BAD-TAIL|';
    } finally {
        echo 'FIN|';
    }
};
$weakClosure = WeakReference::create($factory);
$g = $factory();
unset($factory, $token);
echo 'FRESH|';
$f = new Fiber('Run65Normal');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'before65'), '|';
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|',
     (int) ($weakToken->get() !== null), '|',
     (int) ($weakClosure->get() !== null), '|',
     (int) ($weakGiven->get() !== null), '|';

     (int) !$g->valid(), '|';
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($weakToken->get() !== null), '|',
     (int) ($weakClosure->get() !== null), '|',
     (int) ($weakGiven->get() === null), '|';

     (int) ($weakClosure->get() === null), '|';

purpose: A primed unbound Closure Generator retains a copied old capture and saved temporary Throwable across catch suspension, while an external source name retargets; scalar cache/reentry and callee release remain observable.

<?php
class CopyA64 { public function __destruct() { echo 'A-DROP|'; } }
class CopyB64 { public function __destruct() { echo 'B-DROP|'; } }
function Make64Copy() {
    global $weakGiven;
    $value = new Exception('given64');
    $weakGiven = WeakReference::create($value);
    return $value;
}
function Run64Copy() {
    global $g;
    echo 'CALL|';
    $value = $g->throw(Make64Copy());
    echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($value === 'after64'), '|';
    return 'fiber64';
}
$source = new CopyA64();
$weakA = WeakReference::create($source);
$factory = function () use ($source) {
    global $weakGiven;
    try {
        echo 'SEED|';
        yield 'seed64';
        echo 'BAD-TAIL|';
    } catch (Exception $caught) {
        echo 'CAUGHT|', (int) ($caught === $weakGiven->get()), '|';
        Fiber::suspend('pause64');
        echo 'CAPTURE|', (int) ($source instanceof CopyA64), '|';
        yield 'after64';
        echo 'AFTER-YIELD|';
    }
    return 64;
};
$weakClosure = WeakReference::create($factory);
$g = $factory();
unset($factory);
echo 'PRIME|', (int) ($g->current() === 'seed64'), '|';
$f = new Fiber('Run64Copy');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'pause64'), '|';
$source = new CopyB64();
$weakB = WeakReference::create($source);
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|',
     (int) ($g->current() === 'seed64'), '|',
     (int) ($weakA->get() !== null), '|',
     (int) ($weakClosure->get() !== null), '|',
     (int) ($weakGiven->get() !== null), '|';
try {
    $g->next();
    echo 'BAD-REENTRY|';
} catch (Error $error) {
    echo 'ERROR|', (int) ($error->getMessage() === 'Cannot resume an already running generator'),
         '|', (int) ($error->getPrevious() === null), '|';
}
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume() === null), '|';
echo 'FIBER|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber64'), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 64), '|',
     (int) ($weakA->get() !== null), '|',
     (int) ($weakClosure->get() !== null), '|';
unset($source);
echo 'B|', (int) ($weakB->get() === null), '|';
unset($g, $f, $error);
echo 'DROP|', (int) ($weakA->get() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakClosure->get() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakGiven->get() === null), '|';
unset($weakA, $weakB, $weakClosure, $weakGiven);
echo 'E';
